content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To bake some chocolate cookies, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase organic vanilla extract (45 minutes)
Step 2. Set the kitchen timer for the final bake (10 seconds)
Step 3. Soften the unsalted butter on the counter (1 hour)
Step 4. Research the best chocolate chip brands (30 minutes)
Step 5. Lightly grease the baking sheets (2 minutes)
Step 6. Sift the all-purpose flour into a large bowl (5 minutes)
Step 7. Measure the granulated white sugar (3 minutes)
Step 8. Crack the farm-fresh eggs into a small dish (2 minutes)
Step 9. Measure the sea salt (1 minute)
Step 10. Whisk the eggs until frothy (3 minutes)
Step 11. Locate the measuring spoons in the drawer (1 minute)
Step 12. Combine the dry ingredients (4 minutes)
Step 13. Chop the dark chocolate bars into chunks (10 minutes)
Step 14. Place the cookies on a cooling rack (5 minutes)

Step 16. Add the baking soda to the flour mixture (1 minute)
Step 17. Clean the measuring cups (5 minutes)
Step 18. Pour the vanilla extract into the wet mixture (1 minute)
Step 19. Measure the light brown sugar (3 minutes)
Step 20. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (15 minutes)
Step 21. Cream the butter and sugars together (8 minutes)
Step 22. Fold the chocolate chunks into the dough (5 minutes)
Step 23. Place the baking sheets in the center rack (1 minute)
Step 24. Find the parchment paper (2 minutes)
Step 25. Check the expiration date on the baking soda (1 minute)
Step 26. Let the dough chill in the refrigerator (2 hours)
Step 27. Sharpen the kitchen knife (10 minutes)
Step 28. Zest a small orange for flavor (3 minutes)
Step 29. Mix the white sugar and brown sugar (2 minutes)
Step 30. Beat in the eggs one at a time (4 minutes)
Step 31. Inventory the pantry for supplies (10 minutes)
Step 32. Drive to the grocery store (20 minutes)

Step 34. Shape the dough into one-inch balls (15 minutes)
Step 35. Soften the cream cheese for the secret texture (1 hour)
Step 36. Sift the cocoa powder to remove lumps (5 minutes)

Step 38. Take the chocolate out of the cupboard (30 seconds)
Step 39. Wash your hands thoroughly (40 seconds)
Step 40. Scrape down the sides of the bowl (1 minute)

Step 51. Plug in the electric hand mixer (30 seconds)
Step 52. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients (10 minutes)
Step 53. Melt a small portion of butter (2 minutes)
Step 54. Wipe down the kitchen counters (5 minutes)
Step 55. Check the oven thermometer (1 minute)
Step 56. Open the bag of brown sugar (30 seconds)
Step 57. Select the proper mixing attachment (1 minute)
Step 58. Double check the recipe measurements (5 minutes)
Step 59. Mix in the vanilla and salt (2 minutes)
Step 60. Toast the walnuts for extra crunch (8 minutes)
Step 61. Bake the cookies (12 minutes)
Step 62. Prepare the cooling area (5 minutes)
Step 63. Clear space in the fridge for chilling (5 minutes)
Step 64. Put on a kitchen apron (30 seconds)
Step 65. Let the toasted walnuts cool (10 minutes)
Step 66. Fold the walnuts into the dough (3 minutes)
Step 67. Buy the dark chocolate bars (15 minutes)
Step 68. Extract the seeds from a vanilla bean (5 minutes)
Step 69. Sift the powdered sugar (4 minutes)
Step 70. Level the measuring cups (2 minutes)
